name: showbook
description: Show file library and documentation generator for video switchers: inspect, edit, version, document and convert Barco Event Master and Analog Way LivePremier shows, and move them to and from live hardware.

scripts.lite:wasm: cd src-tauri && cargo build -p showbook-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../lite/pkg --out-name showbook target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/showbook_wasm.wasm && cp ../lite/pkg/showbook.d.ts ../lite/showbook-core.d.ts
